name: Introductory Discovery Call
description: A short conversation to understand your goals, discuss fit, and identify a useful next step.
audience: Founders and business leaders exploring a technology or product challenge.
problem: You need to clarify where to start and which engagement fits.
features: High-level discussion of goals and constraints
engagementModel: Introductory conversation, 20–30 minutes. Detailed analysis and implementation are scoped separately.

name: Business Website Build
description: A professional website or online store tailored to your business, with a clear launch and handover plan.
audience: Business owners establishing or improving their digital presence.
problem: Your website is missing, outdated, or difficult to manage.
features: Agreed pages, design, and CMS setup
engagementModel: Project fee based on agreed pages, functionality, content responsibilities, and review rounds. Hosting and third-party subscriptions are identified separately.

name: Website Care & Maintenance
description: Keep your website maintained with a defined monthly allocation for updates, monitoring, and minor improvements.
audience: Businesses with an existing website or a newly launched site.
problem: Routine website maintenance and updates have no clear owner.
features: Monitoring and issue triage within defined service hours
Monthly review of completed work and priorities
engagementModel: Monthly care plan with covered tasks, capacity, response expectations, and exclusions agreed in writing. New features, redesigns, emergency cover, and third-party fees are scoped separately.

name: Customer Support System Setup
description: Organize customer inquiries with ticketing, a knowledge base, and clearly defined support workflows.
audience: Businesses moving beyond scattered inboxes and manual inquiry routing.
problem: Inquiries are difficult to track, route, and resolve consistently.
features: Support platform and ticket routing setup
Escalation rules, testing, and team handover
engagementModel: Setup project. Software subscriptions are separate. Human support-agent staffing and round-the-clock coverage are excluded.

name: Business Workflow Automation
description: Connect tools and automate an agreed set of repetitive business tasks.
audience: Business owners and teams handling recurring administrative work.
problem: Manual follow-ups, data entry, reminders, and reports consume time.
features: Workflow mapping and agreed automation design
engagementModel: Setup project priced by workflow complexity and usage. Third-party subscriptions, usage fees, and additional workflows are agreed separately.

name: Support & Automation Management
description: Maintain and improve the support systems and automations already in place.
audience: Businesses needing an ongoing owner for configured support technology or workflows.
problem: Automations and support tools need monitoring, troubleshooting, and configuration updates.
features: Monitoring of the agreed systems and workflows
Troubleshooting and configuration within monthly capacity
Periodic service review and improvement priorities
engagementModel: Monthly agreement for named systems, usage limits, service hours, response expectations, and exclusions. Human support staffing, new workflow builds, and 24-hour coverage are excluded.

name: Product Discovery Sprint
description: Clarify what to build before committing to implementation.
audience: Founders and teams planning an MVP or resolving competing product priorities.
problem: Unclear requirements and priorities make delivery difficult to scope.
features: Technical feasibility review and delivery roadmap
engagementModel: Fixed-scope assessment with agreed workshops, deliverables, and review points.

name: Fractional Technical Product Management
description: Ongoing product direction, prioritization, and stakeholder coordination within an agreed monthly allocation.
audience: Growing teams that need technical product leadership on a fractional basis.
problem: Backlog uncertainty and product-engineering misalignment slow delivery decisions.
features: Delivery risk and product performance reviews
engagementModel: Monthly advisory retainer. Capacity, responsibilities, meeting cadence, and response expectations are defined in writing.

name: Custom Software Engineering
description: Build an agreed application, backend, or integration through reviewed delivery milestones.
audience: Businesses with a defined software need and an owner for delivery decisions.
problem: Manual workflows, disconnected systems, or an MVP require hands-on implementation.
engagementModel: Custom delivery project with agreed scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, and responsibilities. Ongoing support is scoped separately.
